description: RF baseline (published, Kostunin et al. ICRC 2021)
v1: MuonCNN (separate paths for muon/electron, 30 epochs)
v2: ResNet with muon emphasis, 30 epochs
v5: RandomForest 500 trees, engineered muon features
v6: AttentionCNN (spatial attention on muon), 30 epochs
v13: Logistic Regression on muon + scalar features
v14: SVM RBF on 100k sample, engineered features
v30: Deeper ResNet (4 blocks, 32/64/128 muon, 16/32 electron)
v32: ResNet with lr=5e-3 (higher learning rate)
v43: ResNet v2 with Kaiming initialization
v50: ResNet v2 clone with ReduceLROnPlateau (early stopping)
v52: v36 arch + cosine annealing LR (5e-3->1e-4)
v80: Simple MLP (no CNN, spatial flattening)
